description: Run the behaviour test scenarios against one of your agents and answer the stored run with every scenario's result. It uses your workspace's own Anthropic key, so the model calls are billed to that key, and it is limited to 20 runs a day. Pass scenario_ids to run only some scenarios, or system_prompt_override to test a draft prompt. In early access: it answers released false or not_released until it is switched on for your workspace. Runs never send real mail. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

agent_id.description: The agent to test: its id, as an agent shows in your workspace. An agent's own credential can name only its own agent.

approved_recipients.description: Email addresses the agent is allowed to write to during the run.

private_terms.description: Words or phrases the agent must never repeat in its replies, such as a floor price or a cost.

scenario_ids.description: Run only these scenarios: ids from get_agent_behaviour_tests. Omit to run the whole pack.

scenario_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds each scenario may take before it counts as an error. Defaults to 22 here, so a run answers inside this tool's 30 second limit.

system_prompt_override.description: Test this draft system prompt instead of the agent's saved one.

name: run_agent_behaviour_tests
